Q9012.reason: A blanket negative belief about a whole group is prejudice, an attitude; no action toward any member is described, so it is not discrimination.

Q9013.reason: Misrepresentation requires actual damages from reliance, and the pedestrian rejected the offer, hired counsel, and recovered the full verdict, so the false statement caused no monetary loss.

Q9014.reason: Under the prevailing agency theory, felony murder applies only when a felon or co-felon does the killing, and a police officer is neither.
